events.verdict: LeVert (DET) brings his arms forward as he engages and disengages with Harden (LAC) off-ball, and marginal contact occurs.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: LeVert (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Jenkins (DET) extends his arm forward while moving alongside Harden (LAC), and marginal arm contact occurs as they briefly become tangled during Harden's gather.
Harden (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Jenkins (DET) at the end of the drive.
Leonard (LAC) gathers the ball on his right foot, establishing his left foot as his pivot, which he maintains before the timeout is assessed.

Green (DET) reaches for the ball when he grazes Leonard's (LAC) face just after the timeout is awarded to LAC. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
LeVert (DET) has a forearm on Harden's (LAC) side as he moves alongside Harden's path to the basket during the driving shot attempt.
Leonard (LAC) swipes down and initiates contact with Reed's (DET) wrist that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Green (DET) reaches in and initiates contact with Leonard's (LAC) wrist that pulls his hand off the ball, causing him to lose control of the ball.
Green (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Thompson (DET) initiates contact with Harden's (LAC) arm before any contact occurs from Harden thereafter.
Reed (DET) establishes a screening position in Leonard's (LAC) path when marginal contact occurs as he releases his screening position.
Collins (LAC) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Reed (DET), which affects his play at the basket.
Green (DET) and Leonard (LAC) both possess the ball, therefore a jump ball is correctly called.
Green (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Green (DET) commits a take foul on Zubac (LAC).
Collins (LAC) legally contests Holland II's (DET)  jump shot attempt and makes clean contact with the ball.
